functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_deletion_truncate_barrier()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='controlled account deletion does not permit table truncation';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_is_active()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."user" u WHERE u.id=auth.uid() AND lower(u.status::text) IN ('active','pending'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_create_community_ride(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT auth.uid())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.admin_users au
    WHERE au.user_id = p_user_id
  )
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.community_ride_creator_grant cg
    WHERE cg.user_id = p_user_id
      AND cg.revoked_at IS NULL
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.community_ride_enrol_organizer()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.organizer_type = 'rider' AND NEW.organizer_rider_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.community_ride_participant
      (community_ride_id, rider_id, status, joined_at)
    VALUES
      (NEW.id, NEW.organizer_rider_id, 'joined', NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (community_ride_id, rider_id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER account_deletion_truncate_barrier BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.community_ride FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION account_deletion_truncate_barrier()
CREATE TRIGGER set_community_ride_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.community_ride FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_community_ride_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_community_ride_enrol_organizer AFTER INSERT ON public.community_ride FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION community_ride_enrol_organizer()

CREATE TRIGGER trg_community_ride_status_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON public.community_ride FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status)) EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_community_ride_status_transition()
CREATE TRIGGER zzzz_account_deletion_write_barrier BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.community_ride FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION account_deletion_write_barrier()
